inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Hazards Removed or Repaired: During the investigation it was found that a piece of play equipment was broken and cracked and was on the playground at the time of the incident.  The equipment was pushed up into a corner out of required use zone near a fence.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Hazards Removed or Repaired (26 TAC §746.4751(c))

occurrences.finding: AP Cribs - Only Snug Fitting Sheet and Crib Mattress Cover Allowed if Infant Younger than 12 Months of Age: During inspection an infant under 12m was observed sleeping in a play yard with a large sleep mat/blanket.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Cribs - Only Snug Fitting Sheet and Crib Mattress Cover Allowed if Infant Younger than 12 Months of Age (26 TAC §746.2415(b))

occurrences.finding: Employee Handwashing After Diapering a Child: During inspection two caregivers changed several children in a row without handwashing themselves or the infant.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Employee Handwashing After Diapering a Child (26 TAC §746.3415(4))

occurrences.finding: Safety Requirements for Play Yards - Label for Each Infant: During inspection, infants were sleeping in play yards that are not correctly labled.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety Requirements for Play Yards - Label for Each Infant (26 TAC §746.2411(2)(I))

occurrences.finding: Naptime Child/Caregiver Ratio: During inspection 3  infant classes were combined during naptime.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Naptime Child/Caregiver Ratio (26 TAC §746.1613(b))

occurrences.finding: Director present-Minimum 75%: During inpection it was determined that the director is not present at the operation the required amount of hours per week.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director present-Minimum 75% (26 TAC §746.1011(a))

occurrences.finding: Director Responsibilities - Operate in Compliance: During the inspection the director is determined to not be at the operation enough to ensure the staff is supervised and that they are following the standards.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director Responsibilities - Operate in Compliance (26 TAC §746.1003(1))

occurrences.finding: Maximum Group Size 13 or More Children: During inspection 12 children were being cared for by two caregivers and the SAG is 0 - 11m.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maximum Group Size 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1609)

occurrences.finding: Diaper Changing Steps- Prompt: During the investigation it was determined that children in diapers or potty training have not been changed promptly.  The operation has put procedures in place to address this issue.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Diaper Changing Steps- Prompt (26 TAC §746.3501(1))

occurrences.finding: Diaper Changing Steps- Prompt: During the investigation it was determined that there has been an ongoing issue with prompt changes of soiled diapers and pull ups.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Diaper Changing Steps- Prompt (26 TAC §746.3501(1))

occurrences.finding: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children: During the investigation there were 13 children in the infant room ages 5m-19m with a SAG of 11m.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)

occurrences.finding: Infant May Not Sleep in a Restrictive Device: During the investigation four caregivers were observed in the room playing with the babies and two of the infants were sleeping in their bouncers and not moved to their play yards.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant May Not Sleep in a Restrictive Device (26 TAC §746.2426(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Requirements for Feeding Infants - No Walking or Sleeping with Bottle or Cup: During inspection a bottle was observed in the crib with a sleeping infant and four bottles were observed on the floor throughout the room.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Requirements for Feeding Infants - No Walking or Sleeping with Bottle or Cup (26 TAC §746.2419(7))

occurrences.finding: AP Cribs - Only Snug Fitting Sheet and Crib Mattress Cover Allowed if Infant Younger than 12 Months of Age: During the investigation an infant was observed asleep with a blanket in the bed.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Cribs - Only Snug Fitting Sheet and Crib Mattress Cover Allowed if Infant Younger than 12 Months of Age (26 TAC §746.2415(b))

occurrences.finding: Safety Requirements for Play Yards - Secure Supports: During inspection an infant was observed asleep in a play yard that had a side that was not locked into place.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety Requirements for Play Yards - Secure Supports (26 TAC §746.2411(2)(D))

occurrences.finding: Child/Caregiver Ratio - 18 Months Difference in Age: During inspection there were two children in the infant room that were much more than 18m older than the youngest infant.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/Caregiver Ratio - 18 Months Difference in Age (26 TAC §746.1605(1))

occurrences.finding: Diaper Changing Equipment - Smooth, Non-absorbent, Easy to Clean Surface: During inspection a blanket was observed coving the changing mat and diapers were changed without removing the blanket and santizing for the next child.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Diaper Changing Equipment - Smooth, Non-absorbent, Easy to Clean Surface (26 TAC §746.3503(a))

occurrences.finding: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days: During investigation 8 infants did not have updated feeding instructions.  Some children were provided extra food from the classroom instead of the food parents provided.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days (26 TAC §746.2421(b))

occurrences.finding: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children: During the investigation there were 13 children in the infant room ages 5m - 5 years of age.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)

occurrences.finding: Personal use of electronic devices, such as cell phones, MP3 players, tablets, and video games: During investigation it was found a caregiver uses electronic devices for personal business while caring for children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Personal use of electronic devices, such as cell phones, MP3 players, tablets, and video games (26 TAC §746.1203(3)(D))

occurrences.finding: Floors, ceilings and Walls in Good Repair and Clean: * The infant room has baseboard area that is peeling and needs to be repaired.  * The Prek room has an electrical outlet box that has pulled away from the wall and needs to be repaired.  *  Two year old room has outlets that are not covered.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Floors, ceilings and Walls in Good Repair and Clean (26 TAC §746.3407(9))

occurrences.finding: Diaper Changing Steps- Parent's Written Permission for Powders, Lotions, Etc.: During the investigation it was found that the operation used a cream on a child that was not approved by the parent.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Diaper Changing Steps- Parent's Written Permission for Powders, Lotions, Etc. (26 TAC §746.3501(4))

occurrences.finding: Safety Requirements for Active Play Equipment - No Pinch, Crush, or Shear Points: During inspection the playground had the following safety issues:  Large slide piece has large crack on the platform - remove or repair before allowing children on it.  Plastic slide requires loose fill but was removed from the playground during inspection  Pieces are not 6 feet apart from fence or from each other.  A sandbox cover has bolts in four corners that need to be removed or covered.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety Requirements for Active Play Equipment - No Pinch, Crush, or Shear Points (26 TAC §746.4601(7))

occurrences.finding: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children: During inspection a classroom was found out of ratio.  Children were combined in other classses to put this class into ratio during inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)

occurrences.finding: Annual Sanitation Inspection: During inspection a current health inspection was not available.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Sanitation Inspection (26 TAC §746.3401(a))

occurrences.finding: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months: A current fire inspection was not available during inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months (26 TAC §746.5101(a))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pre-Service Training: During the investigation, pre-service training documentation was not available for a caregiver.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pre-Service Training (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(2)(A))

occurrences.finding: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation: This Minimum Standard was reviewed and found to be out of compliance. An individual who had a pending background check was observed at the operation inside of a classroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)

occurrences.finding: Employee Handwashing After Diapering a Child: During inspection a caregiver did not wash her hands or the child's hands after changing a diaper.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Employee Handwashing After Diapering a Child (26 TAC §746.3415(4))

occurrences.finding: Written Activity Plan - No Long Waiting Periods: During inspection children were observed to be sitting in high chairs for over an hour without an activity or being able to get down and be active.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Activity Plan - No Long Waiting Periods (26 TAC §746.2205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Mark Cleaning Supplies, Toxic Materials; Keep Separate from Food and Inaccessible to Children: During inspection a classroom has cleaning chemicals within reach of children and a closet is accessible to children with chemicals stored inside.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Mark Cleaning Supplies, Toxic Materials; Keep Separate from Food and Inaccessible to Children (26 TAC §746.3407(12))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: During the inspection a child was observed leaving the area with the children and caregivers and going down the hall several times towards the door to go outside and in and out of a classroom several times without caregivers being aware that the child was out of the room.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Supervised Naptime Daily: During inspection three children were observed napping in an area that was unsupervised and one child was found napping alone in a room unsupervised.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervised Naptime Daily (26 TAC §746.2901)

occurrences.finding: Child-Care Center Must be Equipped with a Working Carbon Monoxide (CO) Detection System: Duiring inspection a carbon monoxide detector was not installed in the building.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child-Care Center Must be Equipped with a Working Carbon Monoxide (CO) Detection System (26 TAC §746.5531)

occurrences.finding: Storage for Individual Belongings: During inspection personall storage for individual belongings was not available for children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Storage for Individual Belongings (26 TAC §746.4505)

occurrences.finding: Fenced Outdoor Activity Space: During inspection it was found that the playground areas did not have a fence installed.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Fenced Outdoor Activity Space (26 TAC §746.4305)
